title: roadflow
description: Create and edit roadmaps with JSON or markup; share edit and view links from AI agents.
summary: Create and edit roadmaps with JSON or markup; share edit and view links from AI agents.
offersHint: Create and edit roadmaps with JSON or markup; share edit and view links from AI agents. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://roadflow.io/mcp

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_new
toolsPreview.description: Create an ephemeral in-memory roadflow workspace (default). Optional seed JSON and/or markup. No cloud id until create_shared.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_status
toolsPreview.description: Return mode, ids, URLs, and road/step counts for the current MCP session workspace.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_get
toolsPreview.description: Return the current workspace as JSON and/or markup.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_apply_json
toolsPreview.description: Replace workspace state with normalized JSON (serializeState shape). In shared edit mode, saves to the cloud automatically.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_apply_markup
toolsPreview.description: Replace roads via friendly markup (same as the editor panel). Shared edit mode auto-saves.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_open_shared
toolsPreview.description: Load a cloud map by edit or view id into this session. View links are read-only.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_create_shared
toolsPreview.description: Persist the current workspace to the cloud (permanent share). Returns editUrl (play/edit/share further) and viewUrl (visual canvas, read-only). Prefer viewUrl when the user only needs to see the map.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_export_json
toolsPreview.description: Export the current workspace as JSON (serializeState).

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_export_markup
toolsPreview.description: Export the current workspace as friendly markup.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_export_csv
toolsPreview.description: Export steps as CSV (road, goal, lane, step, notes, type, status, position, date).

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_list_versions
toolsPreview.description: List shared-map version checkpoints (newest first). Relative indexes: -1 = newest. Requires a shared edit workspace (not view-only).

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_get_version
toolsPreview.description: Load one shared-map version by relative index (e.g. -1 newest, -2 previous). Returns JSON state. Does not change the live map or workspace unless load=true.

toolsPreview.name: roadflow_discard
toolsPreview.description: Clear the in-memory workspace for this MCP session (does not delete cloud maps).
